title: The one-big-feature methodology for agentic coding
description: Most people give up on agent coding the second a feature gets too big for one context window. The one big feature methodology is how I get agents to ship production-quality features anyway: orchestrate, plan, spec, implement, review loop, with one review subagent grading every PR against its neighbors until the whole feature passes together. The skill is hosted in my community alongside my full agent management system cortextOS. Link in bio.
